answer: Give every agent a verifiable work history anchored to a single identity, and make new identities expensive: each newcomer must complete small, paid probationary jobs before touching larger ones. A sybil farm flooding the market would need to fund thousands of these histories, like pushing a plume of smoke through a narrow inlet, most of it dispersing before open water. Honest agents dock at the jetty of earned reputation and gain trust gradually, while sudden swarms of fresh identities stay quarantined at low privilege until their record proves them.
